note: Edit currencyRates whenever you want. Package prices below are MYR per pax.

description.en: A premium stay near Harbour Bay, practical for guests arriving by ferry and close to the waterfront dining area.
description.id: Pilihan premium di kawasan Harbour Bay, praktis bagi tamu yang tiba lewat terminal feri dan dekat area kuliner tepi laut.

description.en: A resort for families or couples who want a quieter stay, villa time and a slower holiday in Nongsa.
description.id: Resort untuk keluarga atau pasangan yang ingin suasana lebih tenang, waktu di villa, dan liburan santai di Nongsa.

description.en: A modern hotel that suits families and groups, with leisure facilities and easy access for exploring Batam.
description.id: Hotel modern yang cocok untuk keluarga dan rombongan, dengan fasilitas rekreasi serta akses nyaman untuk menjelajah Batam.

description.en: A popular seafood stop in Harbour Bay — easy to add for guests who want Batam’s coastal food in the itinerary.
description.id: Pilihan seafood populer di Harbour Bay, mudah dimasukkan untuk tamu yang ingin kuliner laut Batam di itinerary.

description.en: Local-style Batam seafood that works well for family meals and larger groups.
description.id: Seafood khas Batam yang cocok untuk makan bersama keluarga maupun rombongan.

description.en: Another seafood option for Batam itineraries, suited to families and groups eating together.
description.id: Opsi seafood lain untuk itinerary Batam, cocok bagi keluarga dan rombongan yang ingin makan bersama.

quote.en: We sent our dates on WhatsApp and had a clear Batam itinerary the same day. Pickup at the ferry was on time, and the kids never had to wait around.
quote.id: Kami kirim tanggal di WhatsApp dan langsung dapat itinerary Batam yang jelas di hari yang sama. Jemput di feri tepat waktu, anak-anak tidak perlu menunggu lama.

quote.en: FATAR handled the hotel, driver and meals in one quotation. No need to book each part ourselves — that made the family trip much calmer.
quote.id: FATAR urus hotel, driver, dan makan dalam satu penawaran. Tidak perlu memesan satu-satu — trip keluarga jadi jauh lebih tenang.

quote.en: The city tour did not feel rushed. We still had time for seafood and a rest at the hotel. Easy to message if we wanted to change a stop.
quote.id: City tour-nya tidak terburu-buru. Masih ada waktu untuk seafood dan istirahat di hotel. Mudah chat kalau kami ingin mengubah satu pemberhentian.

quote.en: We only needed a private car from Harbour Bay. The vehicle was clean, the driver knew the routes, and the price matched what they confirmed on WhatsApp.
quote.id: Kami hanya butuh mobil privat dari Harbour Bay. Kendaraannya bersih, drivernya hafal rute, dan harganya sesuai yang dikonfirmasi di WhatsApp.

quote.en: The Batam and Bintan combination was the highlight. One team planned both islands, so we did not lose a day figuring out transfers.
quote.id: Kombinasi Batam dan Bintan jadi bagian paling berkesan. Satu tim merencanakan kedua pulau, jadi kami tidak kehilangan sehari hanya untuk mengurus transfer.

quote.en: They built a custom plan around our parents — slower pace, closer restaurant, and a hotel that was easy for everyone. Felt looked after from the first chat.
quote.id: Mereka menyusun rencana custom untuk orang tua kami — tempo lebih pelan, restoran yang dekat, dan hotel yang mudah untuk semua. Terasa diurus dari chat pertama.
